settings.heading: A study in modern couture
settings.body:
Zaria is a design-led couture house, founded in Dubai on considered silhouettes and refined tailoring. Every piece is drawn, cut, and finished by hand in our atelier, made to be worn and kept.

We believe modest dressing and modern luxury belong together. Working in the finest silks, cottons, chiffons and embellished fabrics, we cut for the woman who values quiet, lasting elegance over the passing season.

settings.title: Bespoke tailoring
settings.text: Each piece is cut and fitted to your measurements.

settings.title: Hand finished
settings.text: Finished by hand in our atelier, detail by detail.

settings.title: Worldwide delivery
settings.text: Considered packaging, shipped wherever you are.

settings.title: Private appointments
settings.text: Design consultations in person or by video.

settings.quote: True luxury is a garment that fits only you, made to be worn for years, not seasons.

settings.heading: Design your look
settings.body: Commission a piece made only for you. Share your vision, your measurements and your occasion, and our designers will bring it to life.
